description.description: A hand-made sculpture of Goku from Dragon Ball Z, constructed entirely from matches, is shown in a sequence of three images. In the first frame, a person uses a burning match to light the base of the sculpture. In the second frame, a bright orange flame rapidly travels up the figure, creating a visual effect similar to a Super Saiyan aura. In the third frame, the match ends are charred black, and the fire begins to subside.
